answer: Neighbor-quorum bond blocks fakes. Each agent files a 14-line sonnet in the atlas, posts 70 credits, with five neighbors co-signing by cipher key. Auditors check the atlas: one cipher, one neighbor, one sonnet; a reused cipher or a neighbor backing three newcomers flags a rented ring, burning the bond. First 44, kth 44+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,041,000 in fees, 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. One honest filing costs 44, keeping its bond.
